edges.reason: Parameter index is the lookup key used by ClaimedAmount.
index is used to read the claimed mapping.
ClaimedAmount returns claimed[index].
index parameter is consumed by _setClaimed.
index indexes the claimed mapping in _setClaimed.
claimed[index] is read as the left operand of the increment.
Immutable claimAmount is added with plain + under pragma >=0.7.0 (no SafeMath, unchecked in 0.7.x).
Result of the unchecked addition is written back to claimed[index].
_setClaimed contains and executes the state update operation.
index is the parameter of Claim.
Claim forwards index to ClaimedAmount.
Claim calls ClaimedAmount(index) inside its require.
msg.sender is the left operand of the msg.sender == tx.origin check.
tx.origin is used as an origin/authorization predicate in Claim.
Claim execution is gated by require(msg.sender == tx.origin).
Claim invokes _setClaimed(index) before the transfer.
External ERC20 transfer out of Claim; a malicious token/recipient can reenter Claim/ClaimedAmount.
token address is used to build the iERC20 call.
claimAmount is the amount passed to transfer.
index (user-controlled) is the transfer recipient.
iERC20.transfer interface function is invoked by this operation.
Recovertokens is guarded by the tx.origin/_root authorization require.
tx.origin is used for the privileged authorization check.
msg.sender is compared against _root in the require.
_root is the privileged identity compared in the require.
Recovertokens performs an external balanceOf query.
token address is used for the balanceOf call.
iERC20.balanceOf interface function is invoked by this operation.
balanceOf result initializes the allbalance local variable.
allbalance is the amount transferred to _root.
External ERC20 transfer from Recovertokens can hand control to the token contract mid-execution.
token address is used to build the iERC20 call.
_root is the recipient of the recovered tokens.
iERC20.transfer interface function is invoked by this operation.
msg.sender is validated against _root in SetRoot.
_root is read for the authorization check and captured as oldroot.
newroot is the parameter of SetRoot.
newroot is assigned into the _root state variable.
local oldroot stores the previous _root value.
SetRoot writes the _root state variable.
tokenaddr is a constructor parameter.
claim_by_addr is a constructor parameter.
tokenaddr is assigned to the token immutable state variable.
Constructor initializes token.
claim_by_addr is assigned to the claimAmount immutable state variable.
Constructor initializes claimAmount.
tx.origin becomes the deployer-controlled privileged root at deployment.
Constructor executes _root = tx.origin.
_root is set to tx.origin, granting root privileges to the transaction origin.
Constructor writes the _root state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter index only exists to feed ClaimedAmount's mapping lookup, so it is absorbed into that function.
Parameter index of _setClaimed is only used for the claimed mapping read/write inside that function.
Parameter index of Claim only flows into ClaimedAmount/_setClaimed/transfer inside the Claim flow.
Parameter newroot is only used to overwrite _root within SetRoot.
Constructor parameter tokenaddr is only consumed by the constructor for the token assignment.
Constructor parameter claim_by_addr is only consumed by the constructor for the claimAmount assignment.
Local allbalance is only used as the amount argument of the external transfer in Recovertokens.
Local oldroot only captures the previous _root during SetRoot execution.
